scoreboard.name: Scoreboard
scoreboard.skeleton: A stadium scoreboard fills the frame, two team crests flanking the score, floodlight haze behind it.
scoreboard.textPolicy: The score renders on the board itself; the headline sits in the band above it.

player_hero.name: Player hero
player_hero.skeleton: One anonymous player silhouette occupies the centre, kit colours reading as pure shape, turf and floodlights behind.
player_hero.textPolicy: The headline sits in the negative space beside the figure; no name lettering on the kit.

table_row.name: League table
table_row.skeleton: A clean league-table panel floats over a darkened pitch, one row lifted and highlighted.
table_row.textPolicy: Row labels are short; the highlighted row carries the only accent colour.

venue.night_stadium: a full stadium under floodlights at night, crowd reading as texture rather than faces
venue.training_pitch: an empty training pitch at dusk, cones and goal frames catching low light
venue.studio_desk: a dark broadcast studio with a lit desk surface and deep background falloff

camera.low_angle_hero: low camera looking up, subject dominant against the sky
camera.eye_level_wide: eye-level wide shot with generous negative space
camera.isometric_high: high three-quarter view looking down on the panel

energy.build_up: quiet anticipation, steady light, no motion blur
energy.final_whistle: peak celebration, confetti particles, strong rim light
energy.analysis_calm: measured and editorial, even light, minimal atmosphere

accent.pitch_green: saturated pitch green leads every accent surface
accent.away_amber: warm amber leads, reserved for away-side and upset stories

frozenStyle.palette: deep charcoal base (#0B0E12-#141A21) in every frame. Pitch green (#2FBF6B) is the primary accent. Amber (#FFA23A) is the secondary accent and marks away sides and upsets. Typography is white and bold.
frozenStyle.materials: brushed metal scoreboard housings, matte turf, clean glass broadcast panels, floodlight bloom
frozenStyle.rendering: clean broadcast-graphics 3D with soft volumetric floodlight, closer to a title sequence than a photoreal match still
frozenStyle.backgroundVocab: floodlit stadium bowl is the dominant backdrop; training pitch at dusk is the secondary; dark studio for analysis scenes
frozenStyle.headlineZone: the upper third stays clear of subject detail so the headline always lands on flat tone
frozenStyle.never: never a real club crest, a real player likeness, a sponsor logo, a readable shirt name, or a betting reference

restrictions.antiRepetition: Hard rules: do not pick the same family twice in a row; do not use the night_stadium venue more than three times in a row; rotate camera and energy so consecutive posts do not feel identical.

textPolicy.rules: Headlines are declarative and never a question. Numbers render as digits, never words. No club or player names appear as rendered lettering; they belong to the copy, not the image. At most one data element carries a label.
textPolicy.legibilityLine: All in-scene text is large, bold, crisp and clearly legible on its own flat panel.

brief.headline: MATCH DAY IS HERE
brief.subjectScene: A single anonymous player silhouette stands at the centre circle under floodlights, breath visible in the cold air, the stadium bowl fading into darkness behind.
